parsed.text: This packet contains fallible location distributions for red and blue on a 4×4 grid at nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Current estimates (represented_time 12 or 12 inherited) are uniform distributions at nodes n0, n2 and n3 in both panels; at node n1 current blue peaks at cell [1,0] (peak probability ≈0.99941) and current red peaks at [0,2] (peak probability ≈0.99579). Candidate conditional records (commands k0,k1,k2, represented_time 13) are alternate, hypothetical distributions: k0 often shows uniform at n0/n2/n3 and the concentrated pattern at n1; k1 for n0 shifts blue mass to the upper-right four cells and red to the upper-left four cells; k2 for n0 concentrates blue at [0,2] and red at [0,0]. Copied or inherited prior records noted in origins are not new current estimates, and native conditional records are conditional branches, not events that have occurred.
